findings.location: content.body.ruleUk: «Якщо отримувача названо через a + ім'я чи займенник, le або les зазвичай теж ставимо»
findings.description: Including pronouns in this statement incorrectly recommends le or les for recipients such as a mí and a ti. The following sentence gives a correct example but does not repair the generalization.
findings.suggestion: Separate noun recipients from tonic pronouns. Explain that tonic pronouns require the corresponding clitic: me, te, le, nos, os or les.

items.reviewerAnswer: Tonic indirect-object pronouns require matching clitics: a mí me, a ti te, a él le, a nosotros nos.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, «pronombres personales átonos», discussion of doubling with tonic personal pronouns (from memory).

findings.location: task.errors[id=e2]: «nos enseñas», with object-pron.indirect-forms/written-form marked «incorrect»
findings.description: The pronoun nos is correct. The error is the verb ending required by usted, yet the outcome attributes it to the written form of the indirect-object pronoun.
findings.suggestion: Keep the pronoun-form outcome correct and assess the verb-agreement error separately, adding the relevant conjugation target if needed.

items.reviewerAnswer: nos enseña
sources: Packet context.targets: object-pron.indirect-forms/written-form assesses «me, te, le, nos, os, les».
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, «usted», third-person verbal agreement (from memory).

findings.location: task.options[id=a].label: «друзям, яким вона пише»; task.feedback.incorrectUk: «фото отримають друзі»
findings.description: Os identifies the addressees, while «¡Hola, chicos!» does not establish that they are friends. The key adds a relationship that the message leaves unspecified.
findings.suggestion: Label the answer «адресатам повідомлення», or explicitly establish that Marta is writing to friends.

items.reviewerAnswer: The message's addressees. Option a fits if they are friends, but that relationship is not established.
sources: Packet verdict instructions: use uncertain when the intended reading requires unspecified context.
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, «chico, ca», familiar forms of address (from memory).

findings.location: task.accepted[id=a3].text: «Doy el libro a Marta.»; prompt requires «і займенником, і через a»
findings.description: The accepted sentence omits the pronoun explicitly required by the task.
findings.suggestion: Remove a3 from accepted answers, explaining that it is grammatical but does not fulfill this exercise's doubling instruction; alternatively relax the prompt.

items.reviewerAnswer: Le doy el libro a Marta. Also: A Marta le doy el libro.
sources: Course contract, rule 3: accepted answers must be acceptable for the stated context.

items.reviewerAnswer: La profesora les explica la tarea a los alumnos.

findings.location: task.prompt: «Ви кажете про квартиру Пабло. Уточніть su.»; task.closed: true; task.accepted contains only «El piso de él está en el centro.»
findings.description: The prompt asks for clarification without requiring a personal pronoun. The closed key rejects the correct clarification «El piso de Pablo está en el centro.»
findings.suggestion: Accept the named-possessor answer or explicitly require replacing the possessive phrase with article + noun + de + personal pronoun, keeping the rest unchanged.

items.reviewerAnswer: El piso de él está en el centro. Also: El piso de Pablo está en el centro.

findings.location: task.prompt: «Ви кажете про книжки вчительки. Уточніть sus.»; task.closed: true; task.accepted contains only «Los libros de ella están en la mesa.»
findings.description: The closed key rejects «Los libros de la profesora están en la mesa.», which fulfills the stated clarification request.
findings.suggestion: Accept this alternative or explicitly require de + personal pronoun and preservation of the remaining sentence.

items.reviewerAnswer: Los libros de ella están en la mesa. Also: Los libros de la profesora están en la mesa.

findings.location: task.prompt: «Ви кажете про будинок братів. Уточніть su.»; task.closed: true; task.accepted contains only «La casa de ellos es muy bonita.»
findings.description: The instructions do not require a pronoun, so «La casa de los hermanos es muy bonita.» is a correct clarification rejected by the closed key.
findings.suggestion: Accept the noun-phrase alternative or explicitly constrain the transformation to de + personal pronoun.

items.reviewerAnswer: La casa de ellos es muy bonita. Also: La casa de los hermanos es muy bonita.

findings.location: task.prompt: «Уточніть su.»; task.closed: true; task.accepted contains only «¿Es el bolso de usted?»

findings.suggestion: Accept equivalent possessive questions or explicitly require replacing only the original possessive noun phrase while preserving word order.

items.reviewerAnswer: ¿Es el bolso de usted? Also: ¿El bolso es de usted?

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: «No, es el coche de ella, de su hermana.»; task.options[id=a].label: «сестри Пабло»
findings.description: Ella identifies a female owner, but su does not uniquely establish whose sister she is. Pablo's sister is the most salient reading; an interlocutor's sister is also possible with formal address.
findings.suggestion: Specify whose sister is meant, or ask only about information that the dialogue fixes.

items.reviewerAnswer: a on the natural reading that su refers to Pablo. If su refers to usted, the owner is the interlocutor's sister, which is not an option.
sources: Packet verdict instructions: unresolved pronoun reference requires an uncertain verdict.
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, «su», ambiguity of third-person possessives (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: «pero el de ella es muy grande»
findings.description: Interpreting el de ella requires the article + de-phrase construction with an omitted noun. The mapped prerequisites and hints teach only full-noun patterns such as la casa de ella; they neither teach nor gloss this additional construction.
findings.suggestion: Use «pero el piso de ella es muy grande», or teach and map the omitted-noun construction before assessing it.

items.reviewerAnswer: a
sources: Packet context.taughtBefore and task.hints[0]: the supplied possessive patterns retain the noun.

findings.location: task.prompt: «Mi чи mí?» and «___ padres viven cerca de ___.»; task.accepted[0].text and task.referenceAnswer: «Mis»
findings.description: There are two blanks, but the key supplies only one answer. The first blank requires mis, outside the stated mi/mí choice; the second requires mí. The error feedback also incorrectly recommends singular mi before padres.
findings.suggestion: Change the sentence to «Mis padres viven cerca de ___.» and key mí, updating feedback and referenceAnswer accordingly.

items.reviewerAnswer: The two blanks require Mis and mí: Mis padres viven cerca de mí. Neither offered form fits the first blank.
sources: Course contract, rule 3: a closed key must correctly cover the stated task.
RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, «Los posesivos», number agreement of prenominal possessives (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: «Що означає las у «Vale, las compro»?»
findings.description: The listening-meaning prompt visibly reproduces an utterance from the transcript, contrary to the explicit restriction on transcript text appearing in prompts.
findings.suggestion: Ask about the pronoun in the buyer's statement without quoting the recording; keep the wording in the transcript hint.

items.reviewerAnswer: a
sources: Course contract, rule 7: transcript text may appear only in a transcript hint.
